parameters.description: Creates a new context in the session or device database if it does not already exist
parameters.name: create_context

context_type.description: The type of context to create: 'main', 'alt_<n>', 'editor', or 'editor_<n>'

session_uid.description: The UID of the session (or device) to create the context in

parameters.description: Links or unlinks pairs of device channels, switching them between a stereo pair and two mono channels
parameters.name: link_channels

channel_uid.description: The UID(s) of the channels to link or unlink (a single UID string is also accepted)

device_uid.description: The UID of the device whose channels are linked or unlinked

no_bus_copy.description: If true, skips copying bus state between the linked/unlinked channels (used when Mixer Engine performs the copy itself)

stem_format.description: The target format: stereo links the channel pair, mono unlinks it (defaults to mono)

parameters.description: Redoes the most recently undone edit(s) on the session's undo queue
parameters.name: redo

count.description: The number of edits to redo (default: 1)

session_uid.description: The UID of the session to redo on (defaults to the session owning the command)

parameters.description: Undoes the most recent edit(s) on the session's undo queue
parameters.name: undo

count.description: The number of undo steps to perform; defaults to 1

session_uid.description: The UID of the session to undo in; defaults to the session associated with the command target

parameters.description: Triggers the identify indicator on a device so it can be physically located
parameters.name: identify

device_uid.description: The UID of the device to identify

parameters.description: Enables +48v phantom power on the preamps of the given tracks via the mixer helper
parameters.name: set_mh_preamp_48v

session_uid.description: The UID of the session containing the tracks

tracks.description: Array of track UIDs on which to enable +48v

parameters.description: Enables +48v phantom power on the preamp controls of the given buses
parameters.name: set_preamp_48v

buses.description: Array of bus UIDs on which to enable +48v

device_uid.description: The UID of the device whose preamps to modify

parameters.description: Starts auto gain listening on a channel, or on all armed channels at once
parameters.name: start_auto_gain

all.description: If true, starts auto gain on all channels instead of a single channel

apply.description: If true, applies the measured auto gain results

auto_start.description: If true, starts listening on all channels after adding this one

channel.description: The channel id to run auto gain on (required unless 'all' or 'apply' is used)

channel_index.description: The channel index in the device

duration.description: Listening duration in seconds (0 = use default)

parameters.description: Starts auto gain listening on a channel, or on all armed channels at once
parameters.name: stop_auto_gain

all.description: If true, starts auto gain on all channels instead of a single channel

apply.description: If true, applies the measured auto gain results

auto_start.description: If true, starts listening on all channels after adding this one

channel.description: The channel id to run auto gain on (required unless 'all' or 'apply' is used)

channel_index.description: The channel index in the device

duration.description: Listening duration in seconds (0 = use default)

parameters.description: Triggers auto gain on a USB device for a set of channels
parameters.name: trigger_auto_gain

channels.description: Array of channel UIDs to include in the auto gain trigger

device_uid.description: The UID of the device to trigger auto gain on

parameters.description: Aborts an in-progress recording, discarding the recorded audio
parameters.name: abort

uid.description: The UID identifying the recording to abort

parameters.description: Rescans UADx plugins on disk, detecting and scanning new or changed plugins
parameters.name: rescan

plugin_path.description: Path(s) to plugin(s) on disk to restrict the rescan to (a single path string is also accepted)

parameters.description: Sets the categories of a plugin and updates its manifest in the workspace database
parameters.name: set_plugin_categories

categories.description: The array of category names to assign to the plugin

plugin_id.description: The ID of the plugin to set the categories for

parameters.description: Clears the clip (overload) indicators on the device's mixer channels
parameters.name: clear_clips

channel_uid.description: The UID of a specific channel to clear; when omitted, clips are cleared on all channels

reset.description: If true, also resets the meter levels and peaks

parameters.description: Creates (or re-opens) an emulated Volt USB device
parameters.name: create_emulated_device

device_type.description: The device type (e.g. volt_876) (the optional ':ADAT' suffix creates the device in ADAT-expander mode; only volt_876 supports it) (ignored when device_uid points to an existing database; otherwise required)

device_uid.description: Re-opens the existing device if a database is found, otherwise creates a new device with the given UID — in which case device_type is required

parameters.description: Deletes an emulated Volt USB device, optionally removing its database
parameters.name: delete_emulated_device

delete_database.description: Whether to also delete the device's database (default false)

device_uid.description: The UID of the emulated device to delete

parameters.description: Dumps the mixer graph to a rendered file; requires graphviz "dot" installed in the system path
parameters.name: dump_mixer_graph

path.description: The output file path; the extension selects the format (.svg, .png, .pdf, .jpg, or .json)

verbose.description: If true, produces a more verbose graph

parameters.description: Retrieves the value of a feature key or configuration setting
parameters.name: get_feature_key

key.description: The feature key or configuration property name to retrieve

parameters.description: Stereo-links or unlinks a Volt device channel pair
parameters.name: link_channels

channel_uid.description: A channel UID in the pair to link/unlink

parameters.description: Moves or copies an insert effect from one insert slot to another, shuffling neighboring inserts as needed
parameters.name: move_insert

copy.description: If true, copies the source insert instead of moving it

destination_uid.description: The UID of the destination insert effect slot

session_uid.description: The UID of the session to modify

source_uid.description: The UID of the source insert effect to move; omit to only shuffle inserts around the destination

parameters.description: Sets the touch state for a target object, optionally within a mix group
parameters.name: set_touch

group_lead.description: If true, this touch leads a mix group of controls (defaults to true)

touch.description: Touch state: true, false, or an integer (positive = touched)

touch_id.description: Unique identifier for this touch event
